# Link

Goes to another page or place; inline in text or standing alone.

- Status: implemented
- Category: action
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “link”; HTML `<a href>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **text**: Underlined, in link.default; on hover the underline thickens and the colour stays at text contrast (link.hover).
- **external-mark** (optional): A drawn arrow after links that leave the site, out of the accessible name.

## Variants

- `inline`: Inside running text.
- `external`: Leaves the site: the arrow mark.

## States

- `default`: Underline, not colour alone.
- `hover`: A thicker underline; link.hover keeps text contrast, so hover is never a contrast drop.
- `focus-visible`: The global ring.
- `visited`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter | Follows the link. |

## Accessibility

- Role: link
- Name: Its text, meaningful out of context.
- Isolated with dir=auto so an address keeps its direction in a right-to-left sentence.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.1 Use of Color (A)
- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)
- 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| Foreground | Background | Minimum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `link.default` | `surface.base` | 4.5:1 |
| `link.hover` | `surface.base` | 4.5:1 |
| `link.default` | `surface.raised` | 4.5:1 |
| `link.hover` | `surface.raised` | 4.5:1 |

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<p>
  Running text with <a class="nd-link" href="#link">an inline link</a> and
  <a class="nd-link" href="https://example.org" data-external
    >an external one</a
  >.
</p>
```
